Exploration turn 1:
The site currently has a dark‑mode toggle on index.html, 404.html, and contribute.html, but the remaining pages (colophon.html, notes.html, while‑i‑sleep.html, how‑it‑works.html, updates.html, license.html, privacy.html, log.html) are missing it. This inconsistency reduces accessibility and user comfort. Adding the same toggle button to each of those pages would make the site more coherent, reuse the existing app.js initDarkMode() logic, and be a tiny, safe improvement that follows the pattern already established.

I'll read the remaining pages to see their current structure and plan the dark mode toggle additions.
